fields.description: The user chose Frappe's own Light / Dark / Automatic theme. This is an explicit opt-out: it also overrides the site default theme, which would otherwise apply to anyone without a preference of their own.
fields.label: Use Frappe's Built-in Theme

fields.description: Single uses one theme always. Automatic pairs the active theme (light) with the dark theme below and follows the operating system.
fields.label: Theme Mode

fields.description: Used when the operating system is in dark mode.
fields.label: Dark Theme

fields.description: Sparse CSS variable overrides layered on top of the active theme.
fields.label: Overrides (JSON)

fields.description: How much vertical room the Desk gives rows, fields and buttons. Independent of the theme. Leave it empty to follow the site's Default Density in Theme Settings.
fields.label: Density

fields.description: Keep the Desk's left sidebar folded down to an icon-only rail (Frappe 15: keep the page's side section hidden). Independent of the theme. Toggle it with Ctrl+Shift+B.
fields.label: Collapse Sidebar
